bundles.title: Fresher Java Backend
bundles.description: Good for checking your Java, OOP, collections, SQL, Spring, and web-flow fundamentals.

bands.label: Very strong foundation
bands.description: You already have a solid foundation for Fresher or Junior interviews.

bands.label: Quite solid
bands.description: You understand most of the fundamentals, but you should still patch a few gaps around data, Spring, or collections.

bands.label: Meets the basic level
bands.description: You have a foundation, but it is still fragmented. Go back to Java Core, SQL, and web flow to make it more solid.

bands.label: Needs reinforcement
bands.description: You should revisit the roadmap from Java Core before moving deeper into frameworks and architecture.

bundles.title: Interview Mixed Stack
bundles.level: From intermediate to mixed interview level
bundles.description: Good for learners who already studied Java backend and want to test their knowledge coverage before an interview.

bands.label: Strong interview readiness
bands.description: You have good coverage and can answer most mixed backend interview questions.

bands.label: Good level
bands.description: Your foundation is good, but you should songthen advanced areas such as transactions, messaging, security, and performance.

bands.label: Average level
bands.description: You know many concepts, but the links between add and your hands-on confidence are still not strong.

bands.label: Not solid enough
bands.description: You should review the roadmap and do more interview prep before callng confidently into mixed interviews.

bundles.title: Senior Backend Mindset
bundles.description: A question pool focused on risk, transactions, reliability, observability, integration, and technical decision-making.

bands.label: Very strong senior mindset
bands.description: You do not just remember concepts; you also understand risk, integration flow, and trade-offs in real backend systems.

bands.label: Strong advanced level
bands.description: You are technically solid, but you should still train more on observability, blast radius, and system trade-offs.

bands.label: Has a foundation but is not mature yet
bands.description: You understand many concepts, but your hands-on depth and the connections between system parts are still uneven.

bands.label: Not ready for the senior bundle
bands.description: You should revisit data, security, messaging, and reliability before evaluating yourself at the senior level.
